text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Before training starts, let's make 
them some refreshments~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Something that'll make Trainer happy... 
Hmm, I wonder what would be good?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"The vegetables are cheap too... But if we 
want proper nutrition, we need meat too!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, since we're at it, maybe I'd like to 
try making some new dishes too...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, the bookstore at the shopping 
mall had a lot of recipe books lined up on 
display.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Right, let's also make something that 
keeps for a while. A cookbook for 
delicious freezable dishes, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Building Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The meat flash sale is starting soon! 
Hurry up or it'll sell out~!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My! I must go buy it before it sells out—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... Just a little bit should be fine... 
right?
